properties.label: RC endo pi-complex of two cyclopentadienes
properties.description: endo face-to-face pre-reaction pi-complex of two intact cyclopentadienes (single dot-joined complex node). B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP minimum; 0 imaginary frequencies (lowest 20.2 cm-1); forming C...C contacts 3.386/3.444 A; this job is the Opt+Freq started from the IRC reactant-side outer frame (input coordinate-identical to ...end-a.xyz); E = -4.56 kcal/mol below two separated monomers.

properties.label: TS1 concerted endo Diels-Alder transition state
properties.description: concerted (asynchronous) endo Diels-Alder transition state; exactly one imaginary frequency -473.3456 cm-1 whose mode couples both new sigma bonds (top atoms 1,10,6,4; watch-pair projection 0.969 for 1-10 and 0.702 for 4-6); final-geometry forming bonds 2.098/2.390 A; endo face preserved.

properties.label: endo-dicyclopentadiene product
properties.description: endo-dicyclopentadiene (tricyclo[5.2.1.0^2,6]deca-3,8-diene) minimum; Opt+Freq started from the IRC product-side outer frame (input coordinate-identical to ...end-b.xyz); 0 imaginary frequencies (lowest 142.8 cm-1); reproduces the independently built minimum gjf/P_min.log (-387.996736503 Ha) to 1.5e-7 Ha; E = -24.93 kcal/mol below two separated cyclopentadienes.

properties.note: same elementary step as step_139cce16; recorded separately because the DAG short_irc machine stage is incomplete (harness TARGET-slot perception), and a barrier may not be declared on a step whose machine checks are open.
